title: STAN has no website — Nepal's chemistry olympiad lives only on Facebook
aiSpec: Build/mirror an NChO site: ladder, archived notices, results, syllabi, contacts; hand over to STAN.

title: Zero published NChO past papers at district, provincial or national level
aiSpec: Retrieve from STAN/alumni first; else generate District (3), Provincial (3) and National (3, two-sitting) mock series with solutions.

title: No published NChO syllabus for District & Province rounds
aiSpec: Derive a syllabus by intersecting the NEB Gr 11–12 curriculum (73 topics) with IChO Level 1+2 entries (150 of 326).

title: NEB → IChO gap map (326 syllabus entries tagged L1/L2/L3 vs NEB coverage)
aiSpec: Tag all 326 IChO entries with NEB Gr 11/12 coverage and a 'what to study instead' column naming free resources.

title: No system for working the IChO Preparatory Problems (Level-3 content is only examinable via them)
aiSpec: Turn the 21 available prep sets (2001–2019 + 2024 + 2026) into a tagged 12-month calendar with per-section shortlists.

title: No practical/experimental chemistry training material at olympiad level (IChO has a 5-hour practical)
aiSpec: Five-part manual matching the IChO practical syllabus, with virtual/at-home substitutes for techniques Nepali school labs cannot perform.

title: No Nepali-language (नेपाली) chemistry olympiad material or glossary
aiSpec: Bilingual glossary of ~500 terms across all 12 IChO sections; translate summary boxes of the gap map.

title: No documented selection criteria or Learning Camp syllabus (Top-32 → interview → Top-4)
aiSpec: Draft a transparent rubric, a 10-day camp syllabus and an alumni-mentorship roster; offer to STAN as policy.

title: No calibrated difficulty ladder (students can't tell district from international standard)
aiSpec: 240-problem bank, 60 per level, tagged by IChO section and Level 1/2/3, with full solutions.

title: No AChO / regional-tier target analysis
aiSpec: Brief on Asian Chemistry Olympiad eligibility/cost plus cheaper online-contest pathways for the Top 4.

title: stemnepal.org (international event partner) is dead — route IChO contact via STAN
aiSpec: Action item: never link stemnepal.org; record the STAN-mediated contact route and flag the dead site to STAN.

title: Site topic tree should be re-based on the IChO's 12 sections with L1/L2/L3 counts
